notes: One entry per commit on top of the upstream base, in order. Commits that change only this file are not listed. lygos/check-fork-patches.mjs (run by lygos/check-all.sh) checks it against git log.

patches.subject: feat(bitcoin): show bare input scripts and let callers name bare scripts
patches.reason: Upstream candidate: show the spent script hex for inputs with no address form (as outputs already do), and add a hook for callers to name bare scripts, told whether a spent script is verified or only claimed.

patches.subject: feat(bitcoin-owned): label owned bare scripts by exact bytes
patches.reason: Ours: label a bare script only when its bytes equal a script the wallet supplied, and a vault-withdrawal policy that refuses unverified inputs and unlabelled bare scripts.

patches.subject: feat(display-core): one WebAssembly export for the Bitcoin display
patches.reason: Ours: display-core, the single WebAssembly export display(psbt, network, owned, policy) returning the payload and its digest or a refusal code, never throwing.

patches.subject: fix(bitcoin-owned): labels must start with "Your "
patches.reason: Ours: owned labels must start with 'Your ' (superseded by the closed pattern in fc9a47f).

patches.subject: fix(display-core): move out of the upstream workspace
patches.reason: Ours: move display-core into its own workspace so secp256k1 lowmemory never reaches upstream crates or make -C src build.

patches.subject: fix(display-core): put the engine identity in the digest
patches.reason: Ours: the digest covers a compiled-in engine identity: sha256(engine || newline || payload).

patches.subject: refactor(bitcoin): own Send + Sync recognizers on the converter
patches.reason: Upstream candidate: rework the hook to the repo's style (Send + Sync recognizers owned by the converter, registrable), check recognizer output where it enters, one rule for bare scripts, reserved parser labels.

patches.subject: test(bitcoin): a REGEN_FIXTURES run can never pass as a check
patches.reason: Upstream candidate: a test run with REGEN_FIXTURES set rewrites goldens and then fails, so it can never pass as a check.

patches.subject: fix(bitcoin-owned): bare owned scripts, stricter labels, owned hook
patches.reason: Ours: adapt to the reworked hook; only bare scripts can be owned; no shared labels; label rules (superseded by fc9a47f); REGEN check in our tests.

patches.subject: fix(bitcoin-owned): vault withdrawal renders only signed or verified data
patches.reason: Ours: under vault-withdrawal refuse unsigned PSBT fields, an owned OP_RETURN or witness program, and duplicate inputs, so only signed or verified data is rendered.

patches.subject: fix(display-core): same wasm bytes from any checkout path
patches.reason: Ours: build the wasm through one fixed source path so its bytes do not depend on the checkout folder; check-reproducible.sh proves it.

patches.subject: chore(lygos): checks that fail loudly, and the wallet's rules
patches.reason: Ours: run-goldens pins goldens and counts; lygos/check-all.sh runs every check; WALLET-RULES.md records the wallet's rules.

patches.subject: fix(bitcoin): recognizer rows cannot pass for parser rows
patches.reason: Upstream candidate: recognizer row labels are compared on letters and digits only, so near-copies of parser labels are refused; label tests cover runtime-built labels and pin the label sites.

patches.subject: fix(bitcoin-owned): labels are a closed pattern; test the witness-program refusal
patches.reason: Ours: owned labels are the closed pattern ^Your (new )?vault #[0-9]{1,4}$ with distinct vault numbers; test the witness-program half of owned-script-not-vault.

patches.subject: fix(display-core): pin the wasm hash and the tools that build it
patches.reason: Ours: pin the wasm sha256 in WASM-SHA256, require exact tool versions, build in a cleared environment, refuse cargo config files and an unsafe build directory; BUILD.md for verifiers.

patches.subject: chore(lygos): check-all pins tests, the wasm hash, patches and linked chains
patches.reason: Ours: check-all pins test counts and fails on ignored tests, compares the wasm to WASM-SHA256, runs the reproducibility, patch-manifest and linked-chains checks.

patches.subject: fix(lygos): check-all keeps the reproducibility build logs
patches.reason: Ours: a fully passing check-all exited 1 because it tried to remove the reproducibility dir that still holds the build logs; keep the logs.
